verdict.rationale: Unit is a financial infrastructure platform that handles sensitive customer and transaction data, so a policy or control on AI-training use of that data is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack has no AI-training opt-out, data-use policy or related control. SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS compliance are adjacent security certifications and do not address AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
